_comment: Cards that exist only for tests/unit/casting/test_playable_cast_only.py. Never part of a deck list; loaded by the test registry fixture alongside data/cards/. `t_hostage_heist` is Hostage Taker's 'you may cast that card for as long as it remains exiled' on a plain `exile` of an opponent's hand, and `t_play_heist` is the same with 'play', the counterfactual. `t_gonti_heist` is Gonti, Lord of Luxury's cast-only permission on `look_at_top` to exile, face down.

cards.name: Test Hostage Heist
cards.oracle_text: Exile all cards from each opponent's hand. You may cast them for as long as they remain exiled.

cards.name: Test Play Heist
cards.oracle_text: Exile all cards from each opponent's hand. You may play them for as long as they remain exiled.

cards.name: Test Gonti Heist
cards.oracle_text: Look at the top card of each opponent's library, then exile it face down. You may cast that card for as long as it remains exiled.
